name: fw-app-dev
description: Expert-level development skill for building, debugging, and migrating Freshworks Platform 3.0 custom apps. Provides /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor commands.

interface.shortDescription: Platform 3.0 apps: manifest, requests, OAuth, serverless, and Crayons UI.
interface.longDescription: Enforces Platform 3.0 patterns with slash commands /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor. For structured pre-submission review, use the fw-review skill. Does not install FDK or Node — use the fw-setup skill for the toolchain.

commands.name: fdk-fix
commands.description: Fix all platform validation errors and lint errors

commands.name: fdk-migrate
commands.description: Migrate Platform 2.3 (2.x), FDK 9.x, Node 18 → Platform 3.0, FDK 10, Node 24

commands.name: fdk-refactor
commands.description: Reduce function complexity to meet cyclomatic complexity ≤ 7
